verdict.rationale: Canny's core workflow lets feedback become trackable 'ideas' that move through statuses, and its MCP server explicitly supports updating statuses, organizing requests, and sending untracked conversations to Autopilot to capture them as feedback items — directly enabling a PM to convert a submission into an actionable, tracked item without leaving their tools. Missing for 10: evidence of direct integration/creation of tasks in external PM tools (e.g., Jira/Linear ticket creation) and independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP workflow-status feature.
